concerns.text: T027 defines the sensitivity sweep set as '{<0.05, 0.1}', which is syntactically invalid and contradicts Spec US-3 Acceptance Scenario 2 (which explicitly lists {0.01, 0.05, 0.1}). This task cannot execute as written to satisfy FR-007/SC-004.

T040 requires saving dataset metadata to 'data/results/dataset_metadata.json', but T011 (Phase 3) already mandates logging this exact data (dataset version ID, checksum) to 'data/results/tracing_log.jsonl'. This creates a redundant/conflicting implementation path for the same Data Hygiene requirement (Constitution Principle III), risking inconsistent artifacts.

T012 description requires saving 'cluster_centers.json' with internal flags, but the rejection notes (implied by the 'null-hypothesis flagging' requirement in the task text) suggest a separate 'data/results/null_hypothesis_flag.json' might be expected. The task description lacks a clear, single artifact definition for the null-hypothesis output required by FR-002/US-1 Scenario 2.

T043 requires logging memory warnings to 'data/results/memory_warning.log', but T011 (Phase 3) already mandates logging memory profiles to 'data/results/memory_profile_raw.jsonl'. This creates a fragmented audit trail for the same SC-005 memory constraint without clarifying if one replaces the other.
